alt: The original SimTower title artwork behind the opening New Tower, Load Saved Tower and Quit controls.
caption: Starting SimTower, corresponding to manual pp. 8-9. The title screen and opening controls use the original game resources.

alt: A small tower with offices, fast food, a standard elevator and its initial Tool Bar.
caption: The first few floors: start with a lobby, then add workplaces, food and a route between them. Recreated from manual pp. 10-13 using the current game.

alt: The original office inspection panel with its evaluation bar and rent selection.
caption: Inspecting an office, as in manual pp. 11-12 and 39-40. The panel is the game's actual bitmap-backed dialog.

alt: The Edit window, Map, Info Bar and expanded Tool Bar around a developed tower.
caption: The desktop layout, recreating the overview on manual pp. 9 and 30. The small panels can be moved independently.

alt: The Info Bar showing the clock, weekday and quarter, rating, funds and population.
caption: The status information described on manual pp. 24 and 33-34. The native clock, stars and field layout are reused.

alt: A developed tower with its Tool Bar and native construction artwork.
caption: Construction tools and placement context, recreating manual pp. 43-46. Floor edges retain the original emergency scaffolding.

alt: The actual Elevator window with day programs, response, departure delay and live car columns.
caption: The controls described on manual pp. 15-16 and 34-38. Day selection and time periods retain their original layout.

alt: A selected shaft in the Simulate view.
caption: The selected-elevator preview, corresponding to manual p. 38. Resume restores the ordinary tower.

alt: The condominium panel showing occupancy, evaluation and its locked sale price.
caption: Condo inspection, recreating manual pp. 49 and 60. An occupied condo's price control is locked.

alt: A hotel Facility window using the current original room preview and guest portraits.
caption: Hotel inspection, based on manual pp. 18-20 and 48-49. Hotel arrivals, dinner outings and checkout are separate states.

alt: The fast-food Facility window with patronage and daily profit.
caption: Food business inspection, recreating manual pp. 12, 55 and 58-59. Actual admissions determine closing receipts.

alt: The actual Theatre window with title, duration and audience portraits.
caption: Theatre management, corresponding to manual pp. 42, 50 and 60. Entrance and exit are on different levels.

alt: The original movie selection dialog.
caption: Change Movie offers the original New Movie and Old Classic choices, as on manual p. 42.

alt: Original parking ramps and car spaces below the lobby.
caption: Underground parking and its ramp column, recreating manual pp. 49-50. The original ramp artwork is used.

alt: The underground station, recycling center and parking levels in the current game.
caption: The service basement, replacing the facility illustrations on manual p. 51 with a captured current-game scene.

alt: A person inspection with portrait, home, destination and stress information.
caption: Individual inspection, recreating manual pp. 17-18 and 40-41. Persistent identities can be named and followed.

alt: The actual Find Person dialog.
caption: Find Person, corresponding to manual pp. 41-42. Naming an inhabitant makes the identity available for tracking.

alt: Evaluation map and color-coded tower.
caption: Evaluation view, recreating manual pp. 17 and 31. Diagnostic selection pauses the game.

alt: Pricing map and its four price-tier colors.
caption: Pricing view, corresponding to manual p. 32. Price and satisfaction are separate diagnostics.

alt: Hotel map highlighting dirty and neglected room conditions.
caption: Hotel view, corresponding to manual p. 32. Use it to identify cleaning failures before they spread.

alt: The actual Finance window with quarter accounts and balance fields.
caption: Quarterly finances, recreating manual pp. 13 and 38-39. The original panel's figures use its multiply-by-100 convention.

alt: The original VIP announcement over the current tower.
caption: VIP arrival, recreating manual p. 53. The selected suite and guest belong to the persistent simulation.

alt: Fire and the original rescue helicopter above a captured current tower.
caption: Emergency response, replacing the fire illustration on manual pp. 28-29 and 53 with the current game's original sprites.

alt: The original bomb-demand dialog over the current game.
caption: The bomb decision, recreating manual p. 52. Search and the deadline are part of the simulation.

alt: The cathedral's original five-level artwork and ceremony figures at the roof.
caption: The 100F landmark and ceremony, recreating manual pp. 26 and 52. The art and actor resources come from the original game.
